tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the business software and merchant services categories SMB Compare prices in a country (US, UK or AU), and whether quotes are available in each. Each category lists the calculator inputs compare accepts for it.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Ranks providers in a category by estimated monthly cost at the user's own numbers (card volume, average sale, employees, users, and so on), for the US, the UK or Australia. Returns links to the comparison table and provider pages, and quote links where quotes are available. Examples: EFTPOS and card

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Lists the providers in a category (US, UK or AU) that have a current offer recorded on SMB Compare, with each offer's headline and a link to its details on our site.
